label: Modal ontological argument on the case profile gives a necessary concretum
meaning: On one case signature σ, profile m and standpoint w. All five inputs are supplied premises; nothing is derived about them. The possibility premise gives an accessible world v with a concrete GOD_4. The boxed conditional at w makes G (some concrete GOD_4 exists) necessary at v. Euclidean access at w only (1b1462e6) gives v access to every world accessible from w, so G holds at all of them: a de dicto box, whose witnesses may differ. Reflexivity at w (2b20b5af) gives a concrete GOD_4 x existing at w, and the persistence bridge makes x exist at every accessible world, because the box supplies some concrete GOD_4 there. The conclusion NecessaryConcreteAt (b19ffd92) takes that same x with its concreteness, existence at w and NecessaryAt at w; x's GOD_4-hood is used to apply the bridge but is not part of the conclusion. Concreteness and GOD_4-hood come only from the possibility premise. The bridge assumes no uniqueness; the stronger rigidity sibling is registered as strengthening it and is not used. Neither Scott's nor Gödel's NecessaryExistence is used, so no Gödel–Scott sense or God concept is identified with GOD_4. No excluded middle. SuccessorConnected (0523281a) is the exact frame condition for the forward escalation over all G; EuclideanAt is used because it is already a root-path premise and the proof needs only one successor step. The controls show each of the three new premises is needed and that the conclusion does not entail rigidity.
